title: Data-driven forced response analysis with min-max representations of nonlinear restoring forces
summary: This paper discusses a novel data-driven nonlinearity identification method for mechanical systems with nonlinear restoring forces such as polynomial, piecewise-linear, and general displacement-dependent nonlinearities. The proposed method is built upon the universal approximation theorem that states that a nonlinear function can be approximated by a linear combination of activation functions in artificial neural network framework.
